note: Files: studies/rlneurons/results/wsp1/full500/top8_plain-01/per_problem.json; T3.jsonl fetched from s3://pg-lineage-769063704696/results/rlneurons/r4/modal_t3-01/t3/T3.jsonl into runs/theory-tests/s3k/r4/modal_t3-01/t3/. Q = top8 rows with score_v3 present, first per problem_index, score_v3 == 0, cap_hit is False, n_generated <= 2000. T3: first row per problem_index, v3 = rln4_lib.grade_v3(gold, text)['score_v3'] (the function rln4_grader_v3.py calls; empty extraction gives 0). Wrong = v3 0 or cap_hit. Bootstrap over Q problems with a T3 row. alt_measured: wrong = v3 0 only (cap_hit not counted separately). 'Quick' is n_generated in top8 (the only length field there). example_row text truncated to 400 chars.

Files: top8 per_problem.json, studies/rlneurons/results/day1_3/math500_base_cue-01/rows.jsonl, T3.jsonl (as k=1). Q as k=1. C = top8 first rows with score_v3 == 1, cap_hit False (no length filter), with exactly 4 attempt == 0 rows in rows.jsonl and >= 3 of those with score_v3 == 1. Problems without a T3 row dropped from both. Statistic = frac(Q wrong) - frac(C wrong), wrong = v3 0 or cap_hit. Bootstrap resamples the pooled Q and C problems together, not stratified; a resample that misses a group counts that group's fraction as 0 (unlikely unless a group is tiny). If a group is empty in the full data the script prints not_computable (the recipe gives no rule). alt_measured: C defined from each sample's last attempt (after cap-hit restarts) instead of attempt 0, still exactly 4 samples and >= 3 right.

Files: top8 per_problem.json; P_math500.jsonl fetched from s3://pg-lineage-769063704696/results/rlneurons/r3/base-01/out/P_math500.jsonl into runs/theory-tests/s3k/r3/base-01/out/. Q as k=1. P: row with the smallest sample per problem_index (ties go to the first in file order; the file holds sample 0 only), v3 from rln4_lib.grade_v3. Wrong = v3 0 or cap_hit. alt_measured: wrong = v3 0 only. The stored 'score' field (v1) is not used.

Files: P_math500.jsonl (as k=3), cue rows.jsonl. Score = rln4_lib.grade_v3 score_v3, set to 0 on cap_hit (empty extraction is already 0). Main self-open filter: drop rows where text[:60] contains a newline followed by 'Okay' (reading the recipe's '\nOkay' as newline + Okay). alt_measured: drop rows where text[:60] contains 'Okay' with or without a newline before it (catches answers that start with 'Okay'). k = number of score_v3 == 1 among attempt == 0 rows, used only when there are exactly 4 such rows. Problems with k in {2,3} or without exactly 4 rows are dropped. E: k == 4, H: k <= 1. Statistic = mean(E) - mean(H). Bootstrap over the pooled E and H problems; an empty group in a resample counts as 0. An empty group in the full data prints not_computable ('report nothing'), not refuted.

Files: T3.jsonl (first row per problem_index), P_math500.jsonl (smallest sample per problem_index), cue rows.jsonl. Problem set: exactly 4 attempt == 0 rows, all with score_v3 == 1, and a row in both T3 and P. Wrong = grade_v3 score 0, or cap_hit, or extracted_v3 None. No self-open filter. a = T3-wrong rate among P-wrong problems, b = T3-wrong rate among P-right problems, statistic a - b. Bootstrap over the problems in the set; a resample that misses a conditioning group counts that rate as 0. An empty group in the full data prints not_computable. alt_measured: wrong without counting cap_hit alone (v3 0 or empty extraction) for both P and T3.
